photobooth.name: Picture This Booth LA
photobooth.tagline: A luxe photo booth rental experience
photobooth.intro: DJ Play is part of Picture This Booth LA, a luxe photo booth rental company serving Los Angeles and Orange County. Book the music and the booth together and your guests go home with prints, GIFs and slow-mo videos.

booths.name: 360 Booth
booths.text: Slow-motion video on a rotating platform, ready to share.

booths.text: Photos, GIFs and boomerangs with your logo and colors. Built for brand events.
